FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Artistry Haven Studios, we focus on providing a creative environment for artists and craft enthusiasts to explore their talents. Our core operations include offering classes in non-hazardous artistic disciplines such as painting, drawing, digital media, and textile crafts. We prioritize the use of non-toxic and low-toxicity materials, ensuring safe handling and storage practices are well documented. The studio is equipped with comprehensive fire detection systems, including smoke alarms and sprinklers, to safeguard our workspace and valuable artwork. We maintain secure storage for tools and customer information, and we have implemented robust cybersecurity measures to protect against data breaches. Our facility is compliant with all local zoning, health, and safety regulations. Regular safety training and established emergency protocols are integral to our operations, especially since we occasionally host public workshops and classes, ensuring participant safety at all times. Our commitment to providing a safe and inspiring creative space is at the heart of what we do.

FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing around premises and regular patrolling by hired watchpersons to enhance safety.
